title: [fast-reboot] counter polling is not delayed on fast-boot
author: stepanblyschak
body:

**Description**

Inside the swss docker orchagent start.sh executes enable_counters.py script which waits until the uptime of switch is at least 3m,
then writes hardcoded config directly into config db. This was meant to delay counters polling threads on cold/fast-boot. However, if user did "config save -y" after that, counters polling is enabled in CONFIG DB at boot and polling starts imidiatelly.

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. sudo config save -y # if the uptime is more than 3m
2. sudo fast-reboot
3. show int counters # counters polling is started even though the uptime is less than 3m.

**Describe the results you received:**
Increases fast-reboot downtime. Counter polling is not delayed till the end of fast-reboot.

**Describe the results you expected:**
Counter polling should be delayed till the end of fast-reboot.

linkedPullRequests.title: [counterpoll] Disable Counter Poll When Entering Fast Reboot
linkedPullRequests.author: tahmed-dev
linkedPullRequests.body:
Counter polling is enabled via enable_counters script when booting
into new image and these configuration is written to config_db.
However, subsequent fast-reboot into the same image will have counter
polling enabled by default. This affect fast-reboot time. As a workaround,
we will disable counter poll when entering fast-reboot.

Fixes: Azure/sonic-buildimage#5107
Closes: Azure/sonic-buildimage#5107

singed-off-by: Tamer Ahmed <tamer.ahmed@microsoft.com>

**- What I did**
Disable counterpoll when fast rebooting

**- How I did it**
Added new command to the counter poll command suite and then invoked it from fast-reboot

**- How to verify it**
Unit test added
Verified on DUT

**- Previous command output (if the output of a command-line utility has changed)**
N/A
**- New command output (if the output of a command-line utility has changed)**
`counterpoll config-db disable`
`counterpoll config-db enable`
